definitions.explanation: A taxi that has no passengers and is available for hire. The rooftop sign or dashboard indicator shows this status. Opposite of 賃走 (occupied) or 回送 (not in service).
More broadly, a vehicle running without passengers or cargo.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered on taxi signs in Japan. Japanese taxis display {空車|くうしゃ} on the rooftop light or dashboard when available. The opposite states are {賃走|ちんそう} (metered/occupied), {回送|かいそう} (out of service/returning to base), and ⟦{迎車|げいしゃ}→迎車：24720_geisha⟧ (dispatched to pick up a customer).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空車|くうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧ (an available taxi)
- {空車|くうしゃ}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧ (vacant indicator)
- {空車|くうしゃ}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (empty-vehicle ratio)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {回送|かいそう}: out of service, deadheading — a taxi not accepting passengers
- {賃走|ちんそう}: metered, occupied — a taxi currently carrying a fare
